title: Collaborative large language models (LLMs) are all you need for screening in systematic reviews

model.params_source: paper Methods/Models ('The temperature hyperparameter was set to be 0 ensuring deterministic responses with a maximum output of 1,000 tokens'); the snapshot is 'the versions released in May 2024' of GPT-4 Turbo

task.subset_rule: all 11,300 title/abstract pairs across the five systematic reviews (Table 1 totals 1552 + 1637 + 1338 + 1998 + 4775)
task.approximation: cannot be fixed: neither the articles nor the gold labels are obtainable (see open_points)

items.source: https://github.com/Mihir3009/SR_LLMs (the paper's Data availability statement: 'Source code and fully annotated datasets with gold-standard decision labels and machine-generated decisions labels with explanation are publicly available')
items.config_or_split: five systematic-review datasets (PARP toxicity, mHCC, mCRPC, mHSPC, RCC), 11,300 title/abstract pairs in total
items.license: the repository ships a LICENSE file; the article is CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 (medRxiv preprint)
items.access_note: Checked 2026-09-19: the repository exists but holds only LICENSE and a README.md whose entire content is the line '# SR_LLMs'. No data, no code, and the branches page lists no branch besides the default.

prompt.user_template:
You are a systematic review expert. You are required to screen a given study by reading the title and abstract of the given study. You will decide based on the [component 1, component 2, component N] of the PICOS (population, intervention, control, outcome, study design] criteria. You will only include the given study if all of the criteria are met/satisfied. Please produce only one label for the given study: "include", or "exclude". Please also provide a step-by-step explanation for your decision. DO NOT generate anything apart from Include or Exclude for Decision. Always provide a Decision after an explanation.

FORMAT:

Explanation: [step-by-step explanation]

Decision: Include/Exclude

PICOS:

<Dataset specific PICOS criteria>

Title: <add title text>

Abstract: <add abstract text>

placeholders.picos: NOT AVAILABLE - the per-review PICOS criteria are not published
placeholders.title: items.title

prompt.source_location: Supplement Table 1 ('Initial prompt used for main experiments') in the online-only supplementary material media-1.docx of the medRxiv preprint 10.64898/2026.02.07.26345640, downloaded 2026-09-19; the paper body points at Supplement Tables 1-3
prompt.verbatim: full for the template, which is a shell: its angle-bracket slots are filled per review. The slot <Dataset specific PICOS criteria> - and the bracketed [component 1, component 2, component N] list naming which PICOS components apply - are printed nowhere in the paper or its supplement, so the prompt cannot actually be rendered. The unbalanced bracket in '(population, intervention, control, outcome, study design]' is the supplement's own.

output.postprocess: case-insensitive; the FORMAT block fixes an Explanation line followed by a Decision line

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: mean recall for inclusion across the five systematic reviews: per review, recall = correctly included articles / gold-included articles; the reported figure is the mean over the five reviews, not the pooled recall
metric.original_location: Results, 'Independent individual LLMs without conflict resolution' ('GPT-4T exhibited a mean precision of 99.74 ... and a mean recall of 95.5%'); per-review values in Table 2, ranging from 91.5% (PARP toxicity) to 100% (mHCC)

cost.est_note: hand estimate: 11,300 gpt-4-turbo calls, title+abstract+PICOS in, chain-of-thought out (up to 1,000 tokens). No prepare run: neither items nor labels are available.

open_points: No items and no gold labels. The data-availability statement promises the annotated datasets at github.com/Mihir3009/SR_LLMs, but that repository contains only LICENSE and a one-line README (checked 2026-09-19). The five reviews' citation sets and their gold include/exclude decisions are not in the public record elsewhere.

Prompt incomplete. Supplement Table 1 gives the template but leaves <Dataset specific PICOS criteria> and the [component 1 ... component N] list unspecified; the PICOS criteria differ per review and are what the decision turns on.

Cost. Even if the data appeared, 11,300 chain-of-thought screening calls on gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at up to 1,000 output tokens is by far the most expensive claim in this group (order USD 150-200 for a single pass) and would need its own go.
notes: The supplement (media-1.docx, 387,236 bytes) was mirrored to external/data/tierb_items/W7129376919/ and holds Supplement Tables 1-3 (main, conflict-resolution and LLM-LLM interaction prompts) plus the error analyses.
